sample_unit: operative report dictations (10 reports dictated by each of 3 physicians)
unlisted_practices: Head-to-head comparison of a Whisper-based speech-to-text model against a commercial dictation product on word error rate for neurosurgical operative reports

screen.reason: The study compares transcription accuracy (word error rate) between Whisper and Dragon Medical One on recorded neurosurgical operative reports, evaluating model transcription performance without testing a specific organizational deployment safeguard or practice.
